t2i_prompt: Clean isometric line drawing of <CONTENT>, black lines on a pure white background, thin uniform strokes, no shading, no fill, no text, no people. One machine centred in a three-quarter isometric view with its front door swung open to reveal the interior detail; a control panel with a keypad and blank display rectangles across the top; a pipe run with elbows and a handwheel valve wrapped around one side feeding it water. Precise, vector-like outlines with enough interior detail to read the function, and generous white margin for tracing into a single-colour mask.
signature_idea: The end user of the water, a washer-disinfector, opened up so its racks show, with the PW feed pipe and valve plumbed in on the side.
strengths: shows where the water goes in the customer's process, which links the system to the industry
the side pipe and valve tie it to Aquemi's world
weaknesses: dense rack grid may fill in at small sizes
could read as a household dishwasher or lab oven
valve and pipe look stainless, not polypropylene
brand_fit_why: Precise, calm line art that becomes a navy or steel-blue mask on limestone; interior density is slightly busier than the brand's spare drawings.
